verdict.rationale: Convertio's own docs show multi-file handling: the web UI accepts dropped 'files' (plural), and the API plan advertises 'Unlimited concurrent conversions', so many items can be converted in parallel. There is no documented single bulk/batch operation or batch endpoint; bulk work likely means issuing many concurrent API or CLI calls. The probes found no machine-readable API spec (llms.txt and OpenAPI both 404). missing for 10: an explicit documented batch/bulk conversion endpoint or CLI batch mode, documentation of applying one operation across many items in a single call, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Just drop your files on the page, choose an output format and click "Convert" button.
